protocol.outer_selection: smallest engine ID per subset; excluded entirely from model/scaler/target/query
protocol.query_rule: uniformly spaced rounded indices across current five training engines; no metric-based selection
protocol.model_mode: eval, FP32, deterministic; task and auxiliary gradients separately; no updates

gates.aux_dominance_descriptive: weighted_aux/task gradient L2 >10 on response_body/background/basis in >=3 subsets; reported as selected-state diagnostic only; only nonzero shared task paths, null is unidentifiable
gates.conflict_descriptive: negative task/aux cosine on >=3 subsets in same group and final state; report raw values, no causal conclusion
gates.finite: all actual gradients finite and exact count1120, all checkpoint seals and state hashes verified

protocol.failure_branch: preserve failed diagnostic; do not tune lambda/aux weights or retrain common to rescue claim
limitations: selected eval-mode gradients do not reconstruct stochastic optimizer history
post_failure exploration, not original preregistration or independent confirmation
raw and FE auxiliary context paths differ; their full contrast is not isolated ridge scaling
Local gradient on structurally zero coordinate is not evidence of information use; combine with active mode and actual code amplitude.
protocol.gate_aggregation: separately for each fixed mode/state/group, median of four block values within subset (undefined paths remain null); count subsets passing the same group/mode/state condition, report all profiles. conflict gate final state only. No picking blocks/modes after observation.
